args.title: Update Toast for error toast accessibility and persistence
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider or Toast to use aria-live='assertive' for error toasts and prevent auto-dismissal for error toasts so they remain until dismissed.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/components/Toast.tsx sets aria-live='polite' globally for all toasts and sets a 5000ms timeout to auto-dismiss every toast regardless of its kind. Updating ToastProvider or Toast to use aria-live='assertive' for error toasts and preventing auto-dismissal for error toasts will ensure they remain until dismissed.
